transcript: Speaker A (Boy): My name is Shobhit. I have come to the school to take admission in class 9th. My favorite subject is maths. I like playing games, watching movies, and talking to new people. Speaker B (Man): अरे वाह शोभित बेटा! 8th पास हो के इतनी fluent English? कैसे बेटा, कैसे? [Wow Shobhit son! So fluent English after passing 8th? How son, how?] Speaker A (Boy): English Seekho app की वजह से सर। [Because of English Seekho app, sir.] Speaker B (Man): English Seekho? ये क्या है? [English Seekho? What is this?] Speaker A (Boy): English Seekho, spoken English का बेस्ट ऐप है। जहाँ एक्सपर्ट्स से पहले मैंने एकदम बेसिक लेवल से वर्ड टू वर्ड जोड़कर सेंटेंस बनाने से लेकर उसे fluent English में कैसे बोलना है, बहुत ही आसान भाषा में सीखा। और फिर AI कोच के साथ डेली स्पोकन इंग्लिश की प्रैक्टिस करके अपनी इंग्लिश को फर्राटेदार बना लिया। [English Seekho is the best app for spoken English. Where, before experts, I learned from a very basic level, from joining word-to-word to make sentences, to how to speak it in fluent English, in a very easy language. And then by practicing daily spoken English with the AI coach, I made my English fluent.] Speaker B (Man): अरे वाह! I give you 50% scholarship on fees for your English. [Wow! I give you 50% scholarship on fees for your English.] Speaker A (Boy): सर, "I give you" नहीं, "I will give you a 50% scholarship on the fees for your English." [Sir, not "I give you", "I will give you a 50% scholarship on the fees for your English."] Speaker B (Man): Shut up! अभी डाउनलोड करता हूँ बेटा English Seekho ऐप। [Shut up! I will download the English Seekho app right now, son.] Speaker C (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
